subject: CloudGateway marketplace addendum — resale / billing & audit triage
messages:
From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@cloudgateway.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@cloudgateway.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace reseller addendum draft / pass-through allocation

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was encouraged by the latency numbers. Procurement asked me to share a first pass at the reseller addendum they'd like incorporated into the Order Form. Primary asks from our side:

- Ensure marketplace pass-through of third-party cloud fees (GCP credits) with a clean invoice flow to the end customer.
- Limit Redwood liability for downstream resellers to direct damages; CloudGateway needs an audit trail for fee allocation.
- Annual audit window (rather than quarterly) and a 60-day evidence-retention requirement.

Attaching their template redline (CloudGateway_Draft_Addendum.pdf) — please let me know whether the pass-through language will work for your finance and legal teams or if you need alternative wording. Procurement would like this wrapped into the signed order form within the next two weeks.

Amanda
Procurement Lead | CloudGateway

Attachment: CloudGateway_Draft_Addendum.pdf (redline stub)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@cloudgateway.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace reseller addendum draft / pass-through allocation

Folks — forwarding the CloudGateway draft. High-level: finance is okay with a pass-through for cloud consumption, but ops/legal want clearer language on evidence and how we attribute usage (metering). Questions for legal:

1) "Audit trail" — do we accept customer-submitted invoices as sufficient evidence, or do we require platform logs + invoice reconciliation?
2) Retention window — 60 days seems short for an audit; recommend 12 months minimum.
3) Indemnity cap carveouts — CloudGateway is asking to push liability down the chain; we should be explicit about reseller competence and breach of data obligations.

I've attached a draft redline (CloudGateway_Marketplace_Addendum_Redline.pdf) with inline comments for Ben/Marissa to triage. Can you prioritize review? Amanda — we'll come back with our redlines by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: CloudGateway_Marketplace_Addendum_Redline.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 13:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketplace reseller addendum draft / pass-through allocation

+1 on the meter/logs requirement. My suggested compromise:

- Pass-through principle: Redwood will pass vendor cloud charges to the reseller/customer at cost, itemized on Redwood invoices.
- Evidence: for routine reconciliation, customer-submitted invoices + our platform usage export (CSV) will suffice. For formal audit triggers, require a reasonable-scope audit (no more than once per 12 months) and allow us to redact unrelated customer PII.
- Retention: 12 months for invoice/usage data; if the customer needs longer for regulatory reasons, we can discuss fee-based retention as an add-on.
- Liability: propose a mutual cap equal to the fees paid under the order in the prior 12 months, except for willful misconduct and breaches of data security.

I added inline text suggestions in the PDF. Also created a short MAP (Mutual Action Plan) in the XLS to capture sign-off milestones. Let me know if you want me to send a non-legal plain-language summary to the customer.

– Ben
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: CG_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, CloudGateway_Marketplace_Addendum_Redline.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Legal Ops <legal@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Marketplace reseller addendum draft / pass-through allocation

Legal — forwarding Ben's suggestions and our inline redline. Please advise:

- Is "customer-submitted invoice + platform usage export" defensible if CloudGateway asks for transaction-level traceability?
- Are we comfortable with a 12-month retention baseline (and offering longer retention as chargeable)?
- I flagged a clause where CloudGateway attempts to flow through indemnity for intellectual property claims from end-customers — that seems risky. Recommend we push back and require resellers to indemnify only for their own breaches.

Amanda — looping you so you're aware of our proposed moves. If Legal needs examples of the CSV exports or a sample invoice layout, Ben can attach.

Action items: Marissa to own legal coordination; Ben to provide sample exports; Nikhil to confirm go-forward with the customer timeline.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Partner Counsel | Redwood Inference

Attachment: CloudGateway_Marketplace_Addendum_Redline.pdf (redline with legal flags)

From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@cloudgateway.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace reseller addendum draft / pass-through allocation

Marissa — thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications from Legal/Procurement:

- CloudGateway can accept "platform usage export + invoice" for reconciliation, but we need assurance that the export provides per-tenant usage (we are reselling to our customers).
- Annual audit is fine, but we need a 36-month lookback capability for compliance reasons (not a live retention of 36 months — ability to produce historical totals is acceptable).
- Regarding indemnity, CloudGateway will not accept a full carveout for third-party IP claims if the reseller is a party to the claim; we can tighten the language to require Redwood to participate in defense where Redwood's platform contributes to the claim.

We're attaching a brief redline with the agreed trade-offs. If Redwood can accept the 36-month lookback (export + summarized historical totals) and defense participation for platform-contribution claims, Procurement will approve moving this into a signature-ready order by next Wednesday.

Amanda

Attachment: CG_Response_Redline.pdf (summary of trade-offs)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@cloudgateway.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 11:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace reseller addendum draft / pass-through allocation

Perfect — summary and next steps:

- Accept 12-month retention for raw exports, but provide an archival summarized totals capability for 36 months (Ben: ops to confirm export schema & retention plan by EOD).
- Legal: Marissa to draft language for "defense participation" when Redwood's platform materially contributes to a third-party IP claim; push back on unlimited reseller indemnity.
- Finance: I'll confirm invoice line-item format with billing and share a sample invoice to Amanda.
- Ops: Ben to attach sample CSV and MAP to the HubSpot deal (link in metadata).

Marissa — can you target an internal redline to Amanda with those updates by EOD so procurement can begin the signature run next week? Once we have a clean redline I'll generate the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks everyone — moving quickly on this one.

Nikhil
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
